description:
RSS Feed Reader: RSS, Atom & JSON Feed to JSON

Read RSS, RDF, Atom and JSON Feed URLs and get one clean JSON row per item: title, link, ISO dates, author, summary, categories, image, enclosures. Only-new mode for scheduled runs, feed discovery and archive history for 350+ news feeds. $0.50 per 1,000 items.

Pricing (pay per event, billed to your Apify account): Feed item: $0.0005; platform usage billed to your account.

Runs on Apify as subimpact/rss-feed-reader.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Per-run spending cap in USD (default 0.5). Passed to Apify as the run option maxTotalChargeUsd, so the run stops when it reaches this charge.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return to the model (1-1000, default 50). Truncates the response only; it does not change what the Actor collects or charges for.
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

feedUrls.description: RSS, Atom or JSON Feed URLs. A normal web page also works: the actor follows the feed it advertises (link rel=alternate). Leave empty to read the BBC News feed, so you can try the actor in one click.
feedUrls.title: 🔗 Feed URLs

includeArchive.description: On: also return older items the live feed no longer carries, for feeds covered by our news index (350+ news publisher feeds). Archive rows have fromArchive = true. If the archive is unavailable the run still returns live items and adds a note about it.
includeArchive.title: 🗄️ Include archive history from our news index

includeContent.description: On: every row also carries contentHtml (content:encoded / Atom content / content_html), truncated to 20,000 characters. Off (default): only the plain-text summary (max 1,000 characters) is returned.
includeContent.title: 📝 Include full content HTML

keywords.description: Keep only items whose title or summary contains ANY of these words, case-insensitive. Leave empty for every item.
keywords.title: 🔎 Keywords (optional)

maxConcurrency.description: How many feeds are read at the same time (1-20). Lower it for slow or rate-limited servers.
maxConcurrency.title: ⚡ Feeds fetched in parallel

maxItemsPerFeed.description: Newest items kept per feed, after the date and keyword filters (1-1000). A feed's items are always returned newest first.
maxItemsPerFeed.title: 📄 Max items per feed

maxTotalItems.description: Global cap for the whole run (1-100000). Once it is reached no more rows are pushed. You pay per delivered item, so the default run stays under $0.05.
maxTotalItems.title: 🛑 Max items per run (all feeds)

onlyNew.description: For scheduled runs: remembers, per feed, which items were already delivered. A named key-value store in your account keeps the item keys, and it is written only after a feed's rows are pushed. The first run delivers everything and remembers it.
onlyNew.title: 🆕 Only new items since the last run

proxyConfiguration.description: No proxy by default, which is what most feeds need. Enable Apify Proxy only if a feed blocks your server IP.
proxyConfiguration.title: 🌐 Proxy configuration

publishedAfter.description: Keep items published on or after this date. ISO date (2026-10-01) or datetime (2026-10-01T09:00:00Z). Items with no date are dropped while a date filter is set.
publishedAfter.title: 📅 Published after (optional)

publishedBefore.description: Keep items published on or before this date (a bare date covers the whole day). ISO date or datetime.
publishedBefore.title: 📅 Published before (optional)

stateStoreName.description: Named key-value store that holds the only-new state (letters, numbers and dashes, 1-63 characters). Use a different name per task if you want independent tracking. Not used when onlyNew is off.
stateStoreName.title: 🗂️ Only-new state store name
